sections.title: IRSA (tax on salaries): monthly scale

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

sections.basis: monthly taxable salary (gross pay and benefits in kind less allowed pension and health deductions), rounded down to the nearest Ar 100 (art. 01.03.16 CGI)

rows.label: IRSA: minimum tax
rows.note: IRSA due on a monthly salary, after the reduction for dependants.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Impôt sur les revenus (IR) on business income of individuals
rows.note: annual business and other income of individuals subject to the impôt sur les revenus (IR): turnover or income of Ar 400,000,000 or more, or by option; taxable profit rounded down to the nearest Ar 1,000.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA: reduction per dependant
rows.note: reduction of IRSA per dependant (children under 21, or under 25 in education, or disabled; ascendants without income) for taxpayers with taxable income above Ar 350,000; the minimum tax still applies.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA: deduction for pension contributions (up to 10% of gross pay)
rows.note: employee pension or retirement contributions deducted from gross pay, up to 10% of the gross pay subject to the contribution.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA: deduction for health contributions (up to 2% of gross pay)
rows.note: employee contributions to a company health organisation or health insurer deducted from gross pay, up to 2% of gross salary.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA: overtime and retirement indemnity exemptions
rows.value: Pay for overtime is exempt from IRSA up to 20 hours (detailed rules set by regulation); retirement indemnities up to one year of salary are also exempt.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA: monthly withholding by the employer
rows.value: The employer computes the monthly (or monthly-equivalent) taxable base, applies the IRSA scale of art. 01.03.16 and withholds the tax at source; deductions for alimony and similar charges are applied only on written notice from the tax office.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRSA special regime: exceptional and piece-rate pay (2%, 4%, 10%)
rows.value: Exceptional or piece-rate pay listed by ministerial order: 2% where the unit rate is up to Ar 700, 4% above Ar 700 up to Ar 2,000, 10% above Ar 2,000.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Non-residents: IRSA on Malagasy-source salaries
rows.value: Persons whose habitual residence is outside Madagascar pay IRSA on their Malagasy-source salaries (pay for work done in Madagascar or paid by an employer in Madagascar), at the same scale, subject to tax treaties.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Retirement pensions: exempt from IRSA (civil and military service pensions)
rows.value: Civil and military retirement pensions whose amount depends on the length of service are exempt from IRSA; supplementary retirement pensions and life annuities are taxable.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Capital gains on securities by individuals (IRCM)
rows.note: gains on disposals of movable property (securities) by private individuals, taxed under the IRCM.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Real-estate capital gains tax (IPVI)
rows.note: gain on a sale of real estate by an individual: the sale price (at least the administrative minimum value) less a cost fixed at 75% of that price, so the tax equals 5% of the price; final tax (IPVI).

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRCM on interest and other investment income
rows.note: interest on bonds, loans, deposits and placements (including treasury bills), directors' fees: impôt sur les revenus des capitaux mobiliers (IRCM), withheld by the payer, subject to tax treaties.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRCM reduced rate: cooperative share interest and rebates
rows.note: interest on cooperative shares and rebates distributed annually to cooperative members.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: IRCM on dividends (after a 50% abatement)
rows.note: dividends received by resident or non-resident shareholders, after a 50% abatement (effective rate 10% of the dividend).

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Dividends: abatement before IRCM
rows.note: share of the dividend left out of the IRCM base.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Withholding on services paid to non-residents
rows.note: payments to non-residents without a permanent establishment for services of any kind supplied or used in Madagascar; withheld by the representative or the customer, subject to tax treaties.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Withholding on dividends paid to non-residents
rows.note: dividends paid to non-residents (impôt sur les revenus), subject to tax treaties.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Withholding on royalties paid to non-residents
rows.note: royalties of any kind paid by a resident to non-residents, withheld by the resident payer, subject to tax treaties.

sections.title: Social insurance contributions

rows.label: CNaPS contribution: employer (general scheme)
rows.note: employer contribution to the CNaPS (family benefits, work accidents and old age) on all pay, general scheme; base at least the minimum hiring wage (SME), capped at 8 times the SME. Under review: stated in a CNaPS publication (Droit de la sécurité sociale, 1st edition 2015) on cnaps.mg; no later official statement of the rates was found on cnaps.mg; to be confirmed against the current CNaPS rate notice.

source.title: Droit de la sécurité sociale (1ère édition, 2015)

rows.label: CNaPS contribution: employee (general scheme)
rows.note: employee contribution to the CNaPS old-age branch, general scheme; same base and cap as the employer share. Under review: stated in a CNaPS publication (Droit de la sécurité sociale, 1st edition 2015) on cnaps.mg; no later official statement of the rates was found on cnaps.mg; to be confirmed against the current CNaPS rate notice.

source.title: Droit de la sécurité sociale (1ère édition, 2015)

rows.label: CNaPS contribution: agricultural scheme and domestic workers
rows.value: Agricultural scheme: employer 8%, employee 1%; domestic workers pay a flat-rate contribution.
rows.note: Under review: stated in a CNaPS publication (Droit de la sécurité sociale, 1st edition 2015) on cnaps.mg; to be confirmed against the current CNaPS rate notice.

source.title: Droit de la sécurité sociale (1ère édition, 2015)

rows.label: CNaPS contribution ceiling (multiple of the minimum wage)
rows.note: monthly pay on which CNaPS contributions are due: not less than the SME and capped at 8 times the SME. Under review: stated in a CNaPS publication (Droit de la sécurité sociale, 1st edition 2015) on cnaps.mg; to be confirmed against the current CNaPS rate notice. Unit: times the minimum hiring wage (SME).

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: VAT standard rate

rows.note: exports of goods and services.

rows.label: Insurance contract tax: general rate

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Insurance contract tax: life insurance
rows.note: life insurance and similar contracts, including deferred annuities of 3 years or more.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.note: fire insurance other than for business property (business property: 7%).

rows.note: annual additional tax on insurance contracts for private cars (TACAVA), on premiums and accessories; cars used for public transport or owned by legal persons are exempt.

rows.label: Registration duty on transfers of shares
rows.note: registration duty on transfers of shares, founders' or beneficiary shares and company interests, whether or not recorded in a deed.

rows.label: Excise on telecommunications
rows.note: excise duty on national and international telephone and mobile communications, including internet, voice, SMS or MMS traffic and data.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Tax on mobile money transactions
rows.note: tax on mobile transactions: fees excluding tax charged by electronic-money institutions on mobile money operations.

Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Tax on built property (IFPB)
rows.note: communal tax on built property (IFPB): rental value (declared rents, or 30% of the assessed rental value for an owner-occupied main residence); at least Ar 5,000 per building.

rows.label: IFPB base: owner-occupied main residence (30% of rental value)
rows.note: share of the assessed rental value used as the IFPB base for a building occupied by its owner as main residence.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Land tax (IFT): undeveloped land (1% of market value)
rows.note: communal land tax (IFT), sixth category (undeveloped or under-used urban land): market value of the land; other categories pay a per-hectare tariff voted by the commune.

rows.label: Registration duty on real-estate transfers
rows.note: registration duty on sales and other transfers of ownership or usufruct of real estate for consideration, on the stated price plus charges.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Inheritance duties (collection suspended)
rows.value: Inheritance duties are fixed amounts per heir or legatee: Ar 10,000 in the direct line and between spouses, Ar 20,000 between siblings, nephews and nieces, Ar 40,000 beyond the third degree and between non-relatives. Collection of duties on inheritance declarations and partition deeds is suspended.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Gift duty (fixed Ar 40,000 per child or descendant)
rows.note: gifts between living persons; gifts to direct descendants pay only a fixed duty of Ar 40,000 per recipient.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Annual tax on motor vehicles (TVM)
rows.value: Annual tax on motor vehicles by fiscal horsepower, energy source and age, e.g. petrol cars of 1 to 4 CV: Ar 15,000 up to 5 years old, Ar 40,000 over 5 to 10, Ar 90,000 over 10 to 20, Ar 115,000 over 20 years; 5 to 9 CV petrol: Ar 30,000, 55,000, 105,000, 130,000; electric and hybrid vehicles pay less.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Stay tax: four- and five-star hotels (maximum)
rows.note: maximum communal stay tax (taxe de séjour) in four- and five-star hotels; each commune sets the rate within this maximum. Unit: per night per room.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Stay tax: one- to three-star hotels (maximum)
rows.note: maximum communal stay tax in one- to three-star hotels. Unit: per night per room.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Stay tax: other accommodation (maximum)
rows.note: maximum communal stay tax in Ravinala-category and unclassified accommodation (guest rooms, holiday villages, guesthouses). Unit: per night per adult.

rows.label: Registration of deeds: minimum proportional duty
rows.note: minimum duty where a proportional registration duty would be lower; fixed duties of Ar 2,000 to Ar 16,000 apply to listed deeds.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Registration duty on residential leases
rows.note: registration duty on leases of residential buildings (2% for leases of business assets and mixed-use buildings).

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Visa stamp duty: stay up to 15 days
rows.note: stamp duty on a visa for foreigners for a stay of up to 15 days (Ar 104,000 up to one month, Ar 292,500 for over 3 months up to 3 years).

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Impôt synthétique (IS): rate on turnover
rows.note: impôt synthétique (IS): turnover, gross income or gain of the previous year, replacing IR and turnover taxes for independent activities below Ar 400,000,000 a year; minimum amounts set by regulation.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Impôt synthétique: reduced rate for new taxpayers
rows.note: IS rate for new members of approved management centres and for taxpayers newly registered online by their clients, for their first years.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Impôt synthétique: turnover ceiling
rows.note: annual turnover, gross income or gain below which independent activities (traders, craftsmen, service providers, liberal professions, artists, transporters) pay the impôt synthétique unless they opt for IR.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Impôt synthétique: reduction of 2% of purchases and salaries
rows.note: reduction of the impôt synthétique equal to 2% of documented purchases of goods and services and of declared salaries.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

rows.label: Tax on public contracts (IMP)
rows.note: impôt sur les revenus des marchés (IMP): amount of public contracts or contracts financed by public funds, due on payment of the price, advances or instalments, whatever the contractor's turnover.

source.title: Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026
Code des impôts suivant la loi de finances 2026

sections.title: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances

rows.label: Traveller allowance: personal goods
rows.note: new goods for strictly personal use bought or received abroad, admitted free of duties and taxes for travellers (no allowance for passengers travelling more than twice a month); plus 2 litres of alcohol and 200 cigarettes for travellers over 18.

source.title: Guide de passage en douane (voyageurs)

rows.label: Traveller allowance: alcohol and tobacco
rows.value: Duty-free for travellers over 18: 2 litres of alcoholic drinks and 200 cigarettes (250 grams in total where several kinds of tobacco are carried); one laptop, one tablet and two mobile phones.

source.title: Guide de passage en douane (voyageurs)

rows.label: Cash carried by travellers: limit
rows.note: foreign currency a traveller may carry; above EUR 1,000 proof of exchange is required, above EUR 10,000 the transfer must go through a bank; foreign currency to be taken out again must be declared on entry.
